step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Clause Library.
Highlight the content of the contract to be marked as a clause and click Mark New Clause in the Clause Library tab.
In the Mark Clause form, specify the following fields for marking the clause. The clause will be automatically marked as a one-off instance of the clause for this contract.

entry.p: Enter a new name for the clause.
By default, Inserted is chosen and is Read-Only.
Select a category for your clause.
Select a subcategory for your clause. Options in the list will change based on the category you selected.
Select a term exception record from the drop-down list to associate with your clause.

Select an appropriate risk rating for your clause. Valid values are:
Green
Red
Yellow
Select this check box if you want to make your clause materially significant.
This text area shows the selected text which you want to mark as a clause.

note.p: Scroll past the Clause Text to view additional fields and buttons required to mark the clause.

step.cmd: Click Save to apply clause properties to the highlighted content and mark the content as a smart clause. When you check in and reconcile your contract document, the clause will be displayed as inserted in the Contract Clausesrelated list and is listed in the Document panel under Clauses. Your clause is successfully marked and acquires content control border like the other smart clauses.

After inserting the clause, you can go to Work tab > Doc Clauses to confirm that the clause is now recognized in the document. When you check in the document, any smart clauses can be reconciled to the contract and information of the inserted clause is added to the Contract Clause related list on the contract record.

note.p: If you decide you want to unmark a clause during the same session in which you marked it, you must use the Doc Clauses tab to remove clause properties.

postreq.p: If you mark a table as a clause by selecting the table only, you will see an error message. You are recommended to select some space before and after the table.
